semantic_requirements.finite_difference: must call the scenario forward at x_plus_hv and x_minus_hv for every frozen h and probe
semantic_requirements.branch_state: must be returned by the actual forward call and compared at base plus and minus; no injected branch_changed label
semantic_requirements.structure: must call independent curved straight and direct paths at output JVP and VJP levels; no hidden clean-matrix gate
semantic_requirements.gamma: must weight output and input action scales by gamma_n_out and gamma_n_in separately
semantic_requirements.aggregation: must report each scenario fault magnitude probe count and threshold separately; no pooled overall accuracy
semantic_requirements.status: PASS_STRONG_SIGNAL LOW_SIGNAL_UNRESOLVED or FAIL with an explicit first failing obligation

finite_difference_contract.path_scope_for_three_path_case: direct_path_fd_only; curved_minus_straight is checked independently by output_jvp_vjp_structure_residuals

raw_evidence_contract.input_attestation: record SHA256 of base x and each actual x_plus_hv and x_minus_hv input
raw_evidence_contract.forward_attestation: record raw output vectors and forward-returned branch and diagnostic states
raw_evidence_contract.replay: independent validator regenerates every frozen case from seed and compares hashes outputs metrics and statuses

stopping_rules: Do not edit or delete the v1 source/result; preserve it as red-team negative evidence.
Do not modify v2 seeds, h values, probes, thresholds, scenarios or faults after committing this file.
Do not call a reference JVP difference a finite difference; every FD row must contain forward plus/minus values and actual h.
Do not accept an injected branch label; branch change must be derived from forward-returned states.
Do not use a hidden correct matrix as the structure gate; compare three explicit paths.
Do not pool fault magnitudes or scenario types into one performance score.
Do not select a threshold from this development output or reinterpret D4b.
